Heart for the Mission 1 Bedroom Loft with 1.5 Baths! - Heart for the Mission 1 Bedroom Loft! 3338 17th Street

Large modern 1 Bedroom loft in the Heart of the Mission at 17th and Valencia. Great location near many shops and restaurants on Mission and Valencia and great public transportation options.

Unit Features:
 Large open living space with fireplace, and lofted 2nd floor bedroom and bathroom
 Kitchen with breakfast bar, plenty of counter and cabinet space, and dishwasher
 Painted concrete flooring in living areas and new carpeting in the bedroom
 1.5 bathrooms
 In-Unit Washer/dryer
 Garage parking available for additional monthly fee

Rent: $3150.00
Deposit: $4725.00

SHOWINGS BY APPOINTMENT:

One year lease required. Sorry, no pets and no smoking. Water and garbage included in rent.

**Applications available at showing only. Completed applications, along with the $30 cash or money order processing fee per applicant, and $250 check for a holding deposit must be submitted to Anchor Realty directly. The holding deposit will be applied to the second month's rent if the application is approved and a lease signed. Agent cannot accept applications.
